preconditions.description: The length of the sequence n is between 2 and 30000 inclusive.
The sequence a contains exactly n integers.
Each element in the sequence is an integer between -10^8 and 10^8 inclusive.
All elements in the sequence are distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: is_no_solution or (len(p1) >= 1 and len(p2) >= 1 and is_ap(p1) and is_ap(p2) and sorted(p1 + p2, key=lambda x: a.index(x)) == a)
postconditions.description: Either the output is 'No solution', or it consists of two non-empty arithmetic progressions p1 and p2 such that their elements, when re-ordered by their original indices in a, reconstruct the original sequence a exactly.

postconditions.expression: not is_no_solution and len(p1) >= 1 and len(p2) >= 1 and is_ap(p1) and is_ap(p2) and sorted(p1 + p2, key=lambda x: a.index(x)) == a
postconditions.description: If a valid split exists, the output must be two non-empty arithmetic progressions that partition the original sequence while preserving relative order.
